name: cavemio-combobox
title: Combobox
description: Pick one or several from a list your server searches: results morph between queries instead of flashing, and picks fly into chips.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The field is a button that opens a dialog holding a real combobox: the search input with aria-activedescendant over a listbox (aria-multiselectable when picking several). Arrows move, Page Up/Down jump, Enter picks, Escape closes and returns focus, Backspace in an empty search removes the last chip. Typing on the closed field opens it with that letter.
- Counts ("8 results"), picks and removals are announced in a status region once typing settles; group names are visible labels, not options.
- Leaving rows and chips are their own detached elements, faded in a layer React never renders into, so they cost no render. Glides are measured from layout offsets right before each change and added to any glide still running.
- The panel is portalled to the body with the field's theme variables copied onto it, so it never gets clipped by an overflow and still matches a themed card. It repositions on scroll and closes when the field leaves the screen.
- Search text is 16px on touch screens so phones don't zoom in. filterOptions() is exported, so a server can rank results the same way.
- Reduced motion: no unfolding, flights or glides; the list and chips change in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: options
props.description: – · A list to filter here: { value, label, description?, image?, initials?, icon?, keywords?, group?, disabled? }. Matches rank label starts, then word starts, then anywhere, then description and keywords.

props.name: search
props.description: – · Ask your server instead. Called with "" when the panel opens; answers are cached per query; throw to show an error with Retry.

props.name: multiple
props.description: false · Pick several: value is a list, picks become chips and the panel stays open.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: – · The picked option objects (not just ids), so a search result needs no lookup to show.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: – · The option (or null) for one; the whole list for several.

props.name: onCreate
props.description: – · Offers "Create …" when nothing matches exactly. Return the new option, or nothing to use the text as it is. Throw to refuse.

props.name: max
props.description: – · How many can be picked when multiple; more shakes the row and says so.

props.name: variant
props.description: "field" · A 38px form field, or a 28px pill for sidebars and toolbars.

props.name: debounce
props.description: 180 · Milliseconds after the last keystroke before search runs.

props.name: limit
props.description: 100 · Rows shown at once; the rest wait for a narrower search.

props.name: clearable
props.description: false · A × that clears a single choice.

props.name: width / align
props.description: 280 / "start" · The panel's least width (never narrower than the field) and the edge it lines up with.

props.name: name
props.description: – · Submits each chosen value as a hidden input with a form.

features.title: Asks your server as you type
features.description: It waits for a pause in typing, cancels the request it no longer needs and remembers every answer, so going back a letter is instant.

features.title: Answers land in order
features.description: A slow answer for “ma” can never replace the answer for “maya”.

features.title: The list never flashes
features.description: Old results stay, dimmed, until new ones arrive; then rows slide to their new places instead of the list going blank.

features.title: Several picks become chips
features.description: Each picked name flies into a chip; × or Backspace removes one, and an optional limit says how many are allowed.

features.title: Failures have a way out
features.description: A failed search shows your message and a Retry button, not an empty list that looks like “no results”.

features.title: Create from what you typed
features.description: “Create label ‘design review’” calls your function and picks whatever it returns.

states.title: open
states.description: The panel unfolds from the field's edge in 360ms (a clip from the top, or from the bottom when it opens upward), 6px clear of the field, with the search field focused. Things already picked are listed first.

states.title: searching
states.description: search() runs 180ms after the last keystroke (at once for the first list). The previous rows stay and dim to 55% after 140ms; a 1px bar runs along the search field's edge. An older request is aborted through its AbortSignal.

states.title: results
states.description: Rows that stay glide to their new places (300ms, additive, so a quick second answer never jumps); new rows rise 4px out of a blur, staggered 14ms; gone rows fade where they stood. The panel's height eases to the new list in 280ms and the highlight glides to the active row.

states.title: pick one
states.description: A check draws in the row, the panel folds back in 220ms and the field's label morphs to the choice; its avatar or icon scales in through a blur as the old one leaves.

states.title: pick several
states.description: The row's box fills and its check draws; the name is carried from the row to its new chip in 460ms while the chip pops in, and the field's height eases if the chips wrap. The count in the footer rolls.

states.title: remove
states.description: A chip's ×, unticking its row, or Backspace in an empty search: the chip fades and shrinks where it stood while the others glide into the gap.

states.title: create
states.description: When nothing matches exactly, the last row offers "Create …". Its plus becomes a spinner and the label morphs to "Creating"; what onCreate returns is picked. If it throws, the row shakes and the reason shows in the footer.

states.title: error
states.description: If search() throws, the rows give way to the message and a Retry button (Status button) that says Retrying while it asks again.
